name: MCP Events
description: Subscribe to events from configured MCP accounts and trigger authored automations.

callbackBaseUrl.description: Public HTTPS URL, optionally with a path prefix. Forward only <callbackBaseUrl>/plugins/mcp-events/callback/* to the Gateway's /plugins/mcp-events/callback/*. No automatic tunnel or admin exposure.

maxPendingEvents.description: Pending ingress budget; rejects new deliveries instead of evicting unfinished events.

recommendedPrompts: Check whether MCP Events is ready for my chosen account.
Draft an automation for an event advertised by a connected MCP account.
